ADP COMMAND-LINE TOOLS
======================

These tools are included for convenience. They are less polished than the
player, their command-line interface may change, and detailed documentation
is not available yet. Keep backups when modifying game files.

Run each program without arguments to see its current help.

DDB   Inspects, extracts and runs adventure databases and disk images.
ADPC  Compiles DAAD and PAWS source files.
DMG   Creates and edits graphics files.
CHR   Converts character sets.
DSK   Creates and edits disk images.
